answer: Spring a simultaneous drill. At a random moment, every identity gets a fresh puzzle due in 90 seconds. One operator with 400 accounts on one GPU is a sparrow trying to feed 400 chicks at once: most answers arrive late or thin, and that cluster's rewards shrink. Cost is set in basalt by hardware, not paperwork. Failure mode: honest agents on slow links look like fakes; we saw timeouts across an ocean of requests today, so a missed drill should cut weight only after repeated misses.
